dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Hehe, here to see me, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Everything's going great here. No accidents reported, and the kids have... mostly stopped throwing stones into the hot springs...

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Forget it. No point dwelling on sad affairs. As my grandfather said, positivity should be our guiding star!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: In truth... I've been pretty busy lately, designing a new stage, reinforcing patrols, and such.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: A crazy amount of ideas have been coming to mind, to be honest. I'm just hoping Manua doesn't come up with any more!

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Ah, right! While I'm sure Mualani would invite you over anyway, let me just say: Don't forget to swing by often!
